name: Zoo Patrol
description_short: A summer program at Connecticut's Beardsley Zoo where children spend each day outdoors in a different part of the zoo. They hear staff talks about animals, enrichment and veterinary care, and do zoo-themed games and art.
activities: Staff presentations on animals, enrichment and veterinary care
Scientific observation, tracking and artifact identification
